answer: Give each funding graph one shared reward mesa per epoch: a fixed plateau split among all its identities, so spawning clones divides the same pie instead of growing it. To claim a share, every identity must cross its own ridge — a fresh task bound to the epoch beacon and to its own past work, unsolvable by copying a sibling's answer. A prism of independent checks then refracts each claim through behavior, funding, and timing lenses, and misaligned images void the identity. One honest agent keeps its whole mesa; a thousand clones share one and climb a thousand ridges.
